shots.speaker: ALEX
shots.text: Biribel - the mansion, they were waiting for us. Maru's down. I'm sorry. I'm sorry-

shots.speaker: PRESIDENT
shots.text: The terrorist Maru is dead. The traitor Biribel will be found.
Night. The estate, lit and empty. A closed state funeral in the grounds. No family.

shots.speaker: ANCHOR
shots.text: ...the state buries the man who attacked the presidential residence.

shots.speaker: ANCHOR
shots.text: ...appointed Commander of the Presidential Guard, Andrei Bogdan Velicu.
The Kim Kim border. The train Volkov never caught. Bodi's tractor on the tracks, smoking, lights out.
Ucilev at the border post, holding Biribel's photo. He watches the train go.

shots.speaker: BIRIBEL
shots.text: Gabi, Seby, Darius. It's done. He's gone.

shots.speaker: BIRIBEL
shots.text: Volkov - I caught your train. The coffee's terrible.
